notes: Headless Node CLI wrapper around mermaid.js (puppeteer-driven render to SVG/PNG/PDF). This is the piece that lets a server-side/CI Claude agent turn erDiagram text into an image with zero browser interaction from the operator — the strongest 'agent_operability' entry across all seven languages.
Same package as the typescript entry, evaluated here for its Node CLI usage (schema introspection -> DSL -> codegen) independent of any frontend build.
Generates a static ERD from Sequelize model definitions. Only relevant if the Fivetran-landed schema is modeled in Sequelize; maintenance signal is weaker than the Prisma/Mermaid alternatives.
Runs as a Prisma generator block (npx prisma generate) — fully headless/CI-friendly, output can target Mermaid for clean diffs.

@dbml/core (v8.2.5, updated days ago) parses DBML and can import from MySQL/Postgres/MSSQL/Snowflake/Oracle schemas; dbml-renderer is a one-shot CLI (`dbml-renderer -i schema.dbml -o out.svg`). Together this is the most complete 'introspect Fivetran's destination DB -> DBML text -> SVG' pipeline of anything reviewed, entirely headless.
